primary-mirrors.title: Primary-repo mirrors and backward compatibility
primary-mirrors.value: We don't need a primary term here, all multi repos are in same level in importancy for Agetor and its tasks
primary-mirrors.recommended: `workdir`, `branch`, `worktreePath`, `baseRef`, `prUrl` stay the primary repo's mirrors; `repositories[]` is the source of truth. Legacy rows derive a one-entry array from the existing columns — no backfill. `existingBranch`, `issueUrl` and `isolation` stay primary/global. Document that an older build sees only the primary and may tear down only its worktree.

repo-identity-cap.title: Repo identity, primary selection and cap
repo-identity-cap.value: Again, no primary term here, all repos are important. and no cap
repo-identity-cap.recommended: Dedupe by git root; the first selected repo is primary and can be reordered before the first run; hard cap 10 repositories per task (400 above that), with 2–5 the expected range.

workspace-layout.title: Workspace layout and Worktrees page
workspace-layout.value: Multi-repo workspace is `<dataDir>/worktrees/<task-id>/<slug>` (slug = repo basename, uniquified); single-repo tasks keep today's `<dataDir>/worktrees/<task-id>`. The Worktrees page shows one row per repo grouped under its task, with an opaque id `<taskId>__<slug>`; owned rows still route deletion to archiving the task, orphan rows keep per-row delete.

ui-surfaces.title: Card, diff, filters and progress
ui-surfaces.value: New Task form shows one compact row per repo (branch/base) and collapses to today's form for one repo. Card shows the primary repo plus `+N`. Diff dialog gets per-repo tabs/selector. Repo filter and text search match any selected repo. Context menu gets a per-repo submenu. The agent's existing todo progress stays one shared list; per-repo change counts live in the run panel.
ui-surfaces.note: for repo selection for new task, or even in the modals from Git Integration, we can have a dialog to select the repos and their base branch, otherwise, I think we'll consume too much of the height of New Task panel.

create-validation.title: Create-time validation
create-validation.value: Create rejects with 400 if any selected repo is missing, is not a git repo, has an unresolvable base ref, has an invalid branch name, or has that branch checked out in another live task; nothing is created. `isolation: none` with 2+ repos is rejected with the worktree-required message.

archive-dirty.title: Archive and delete with dirty repos
archive-dirty.value: Archive teardown is best-effort per repo: clean worktrees are detached, dirty ones are kept on disk with their branch, and every per-repo outcome is reported. Archive still succeeds. Delete is explicit and per repo; it never deletes a `branchSource: existing` branch.

runtime-defaults.title: Terminals, polling and extra roots
runtime-defaults.value: Terminals open at the workspace root (with a repo selector); `/tasks/:id/git-status` returns all repo statuses in one batched response per poll; each repo is also passed as an extra root (`--add-dir` / include-directories) where the harness supports it, even though cwd is the workspace.

spec-and-tests.title: Spec and acceptance
spec-and-tests.value: Commit the issue's asks and these decisions as `docs/specs/multi-repo-tasks.md` before planning. Add one e2e spec covering create → fake-driver run → two worktrees/branches → per-repo diff → per-repo PR stamp → archive teardown, plus unit tests for per-repo prepare/reuse/cleanup, nested worktree ids and route policy, and pipeline step copy.
